_comment: What an install of the runner consists of. ONE source of truth, read by two installers: setup.py (CLI) and the browser wizard, which writes these files into <granted folder>/python/ through the File System Access API. A browser cannot learn the granted folder's absolute path, so it cannot tell setup.py where to install — it has to place the files itself, and then only the venv step is left to a terminal. Keep this in step with the files themselves; setup.py falls back to its built-in list if this file is missing.
